applies_when: A few categorical distributions with raw observations
The median and interval are central to the reading task
caption: distribution-summary-lane/caption.md
mechanism: Adjacent category-associated raw lanes keep box/median/whisker boundaries uninterrupted; area color and graphite strokes have different roles.
avoid: Centering the raw layer on the summary creates competing dots, median and whisker strokes; broad summaries add mass.
source_anchors: PROGENy Fig.4c PDF p6: neutral boundaries and colored summary/body areas
Separate raw lanes are an EasyViz adaptation, not a source statistical method
geometry_notes: Adopted canvas: 66 × 68 mm; declared data region: 48.18 × 51.68 mm from the fixed margins.
Three category centers use box width 0.24 category-spacing units. Raw lanes are shifted by 0.28 category-spacing units, with a maximum packing spread of 2.8 mm around each shifted anchor.
